items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I was playing bass with Ralph Marterie’s big band

ctx.x: The first compositions of your own, did you start writing in high school?

We wrote in high school because we had as a graduation assignment in high school, two years of theory, at the end of which you had to write a piece for orchestra, which I wrote a piece for orchestra, for piano and orchestra, and I was going to conduct it, and the pianist never showed up for the rehearsal, so I had to play piano and conduct it. And that’s kind of where it began. I had a jazz band at the conservatory and I started doing more compositions then. Then after that I went on the road and I was playing…
